name: Diver Le Lievre

intro.text: The caves at Gouliot are lined with sea anemones and sponges in every colour. Brilliant diving. Slightly less brilliant fighting, but I'll go.

win: Well. I've lost my breath, and I'm not even underwater.
after: Sark's caves and rock pools are among the best in the Channel. The anemones are nearly as colourful as the island's gossip.
